about_the_game:
The classic mini bowling game from TEKKEN TAG TOURNAMENT is returning back as “Ultimate TEKKEN BOWL” DLC! On top of that, more customizable costumes such as BLOOD VENGEANCE outfits, swim suits, and iDOLM@STER costumes have been added!
*Depending on the type of costume, some characters may not be able to wear them.
detailed_description:
The classic mini bowling game from TEKKEN TAG TOURNAMENT is returning back as “Ultimate TEKKEN BOWL” DLC! On top of that, more customizable costumes such as BLOOD VENGEANCE outfits, swim suits, and iDOLM@STER costumes have been added!
*Depending on the type of costume, some characters may not be able to wear them.
